result.reason: The revision reaches and exceeds the fallback: it limits inspections to once in any 12-month period, requires 30 days' written notice rather than 15, confines inspections to business hours, and leaves all costs with HDI. It does not reach the preferred position because it does not require an independent auditor bound by confidentiality or expressly prohibit direct system access. The change is narrow and preserves the existing scope and commercial purpose. Drafting is generally professional, though the inherited phrase “may ... have the right” is redundant.
